text: In the Habits section within the app, I can't check off habits if a day or more has passed. Please fix this issue, and thank you for the wonderful app.
author: m
developer_reply: Glad you like the app! In terms of the issue with habits, you can check off previous days from the list view mode. You can also click the arrows on the top calendar row to move weeks and check of those days as well. Hope this helps!
